messages.content: Write a short announcement for a new feature in a note-taking app: offline sync. Around 200 words.

Here's a natural-sounding announcement for your note-taking app's offline sync feature:

---

**Offline sync is here**

You can now work on your notes anywhere, with or without an internet connection. Write, edit, and organize offline—everything syncs automatically once you're back online.

This solves a real problem we kept hearing: you'd start writing on the train or plane and hit a wall when your connection dropped. Or you'd be in a meeting, lose wifi, and panic about losing what you just typed. That friction is gone.

How it works is straightforward. Every change you make is saved locally first. When you're online, we sync those changes to the cloud in the background. If you edit the same note on multiple devices, we merge changes intelligently—you won't lose anything. Conflicts are rare, and when they happen, we flag them clearly so you can decide.

There's no setup required. It just works on web, mobile, and desktop. Your existing notes are ready for offline use right now.

We've been testing this for three months with early users. The feedback was clear: people wanted to trust their app worked everywhere, not just when the network was perfect. This release brings us there.

Start working offline today. Your notes will catch up when you reconnect.

**Your notes work offline now**

No more wondering whether your notes made it to the cloud. Write, edit, and organize whenever you want—with or without internet. Changes sync the moment you reconnect.

We built this because we heard the same story over and over: you'd start a note on your commute and panic when the connection died. You'd open the app at a coffee shop with spotty wifi and lose confidence in what you were typing. That friction shouldn't exist.

Here's what changed. Every edit saves locally first. When you're online, we push those changes to the cloud quietly in the background. If you edit the same note across devices, we merge the changes so nothing disappears. Conflicts happen rarely, and we surface them clearly when they do.

No configuration, no learning curve. It works on web, mobile, and desktop the same way. Your current notes are ready right now.

We spent months with early users testing this. What became obvious was simple: people needed their app to work everywhere, not just when the network cooperated. This release makes that real.

Open your app offline and keep going. Your notes will sync when you're back online.

**Take your notes offline**

Write and edit your notes anywhere. When you're offline, everything still works. When you connect again, your changes sync automatically.

We built this because offline work was broken. You'd start writing on a flight and lose your connection. You'd open the app in a meeting with weak wifi and second-guess whether your edits were saved. That friction wasted your time and eroded your confidence.

Here's how it works. Every change you make stays on your device first. Once you're online, we sync to the cloud in the background. Work across multiple devices and we merge your changes without losing anything. Conflicts are uncommon, and when they occur, we show them clearly so you can decide what to keep.

There's nothing to configure. It works the same way on web, mobile, and desktop. Your notes are ready for offline use immediately.

We tested this with early users for months. The pattern was consistent: people wanted their app to work everywhere, without having to think about whether the network would cooperate. This release delivers that.

Open your app offline. Edit freely. Your notes catch up automatically when you reconnect.

Your notes sync whether you're connected or not. Edit anywhere, anytime. When you reconnect, everything uploads automatically.

We kept hearing the same frustration from users: you'd start writing on the train and lose connection mid-thought. You'd work in a meeting with weak wifi and doubt whether your changes actually saved. You'd wait until you got somewhere with reliable internet before trusting what you'd written. That shouldn't be how it works.

So we rebuilt this from the ground up. Every change saves to your device first—nothing waiting for the cloud. When you're online, we send those changes quietly in the background. Work on the same note across your phone, computer, and tablet. We merge your edits so you never lose anything. Merge conflicts are rare, and when they happen, we show them clearly.

Nothing to configure. Works the same on every platform. Your notes are ready for offline use right now.

We tested this with early users for months. What we learned was clear: people want an app that works everywhere. This release makes that true.

Start offline. Your notes sync when you reconnect. Your work is always safe.
